notes: EBIT proxy: DCF uses Quest's consolidated operating income as EBIT (operating income line item). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001022079/000102207926000015/dgx-20251231.htm))

D&A and capex: use total depreciation and amortization expense and total capital expenditures from the 10-K. Converted from “in millions” to full USD units. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001022079/000102207926000015/dgx-20251231.htm))

NWC definition used for historical: NWC = (Total current assets - Cash & cash equivalents) - (Total current liabilities - Current portion of long-term debt). Lease liabilities remain included in current liabilities because they are part of reported current liabilities in the extracted balance-sheet lines. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001022079/000102207926000015/dgx-20251231.htm))

2026 revenue growth base-case is set from the FY2026 revenue guidance midpoint ($11.76B). ([s2.q4cdn.com](https://s2.q4cdn.com/390454341/files/doc_news/Quest-Diagnostics-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results--Provides-Guidance-for-Full-Year-2026-Increases-Quarter-35U43.pdf))
WACC (0.075) and terminal growth (0.025) are modeling assumptions (not explicitly disclosed in the retrieved filing extracts).

NOL utilization % is not explicitly disclosed as a usable DCF input in the retrieved excerpts; set to null and requires model-side policy choice. NOL balances are from disclosed carryforward estimates as of Dec 31, 2025. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001022079/000102207926000015/dgx-20251231.htm))

Comps: EV/S and EV/EBITDA (and P/E) sourced from AlphaSpread peer tables; NTM/forward timing is not guaranteed by the extract, so treat as directional ranges for QA/sanity checks rather than strict NTM comparables. ([alphaspread.com](https://www.alphaspread.com/security/nyse/lh/relative-valuation/ratio/enterprise-value-to-sales))

catalysts: Sustained execution on Project Nova (order-to-cash modernization) and continued lab expansion initiatives supporting volume and mix. ([s2.q4cdn.com](https://s2.q4cdn.com/390454341/files/doc_news/Quest-Diagnostics-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results--Provides-Guidance-for-Full-Year-2026-Increases-Quarter-35U43.pdf))

Integration ramp for 2024 acquisitions and scaling of new collaborations/joint ventures driving incremental growth geography. ([s2.q4cdn.com](https://s2.q4cdn.com/390454341/files/doc_news/Quest-Diagnostics-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results--Provides-Guidance-for-Full-Year-2026-Increases-Quarter-35U43.pdf))
Any material change in reimbursement and contracting dynamics (Medicare/Medicaid/private payer denials and utilization).
company_overview: Quest Diagnostics is a leading provider of diagnostic information services (DIS) and diagnostic solutions (DS). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001022079/000102207926000015/dgx-20251231.htm))

DIS represents the vast majority of consolidated net revenues and serves clinicians, health systems, and other payer/provider channels in the U.S. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001022079/000102207926000015/dgx-20251231.htm))

Net revenues are reported in USD, with operating income used as the EBIT proxy for the DCF (operating income line item). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001022079/000102207926000015/dgx-20251231.htm))
current_context: FY2025 net revenues were $11.035B, and FY2026 revenue guidance is $11.70B to $11.82B (midpoint $11.76B), supporting a ~mid-single-digit top-line step-up in 2026 assumptions. ([s2.q4cdn.com](https://s2.q4cdn.com/390454341/files/doc_news/Quest-Diagnostics-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results--Provides-Guidance-for-Full-Year-2026-Increases-Quarter-35U43.pdf))

Quest reported FY2025 operating income of $1.556B (~14.1% operating margin), providing the starting point for base-case margin normalization. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001022079/000102207926000015/dgx-20251231.htm))

Management highlighted continued execution of cost productivity (Invigorate) and multi-year order-to-cash transformation (Project Nova). ([newsroom.questdiagnostics.com](https://newsroom.questdiagnostics.com/2026-02-10-Quest-Diagnostics-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results-Provides-Guidance-for-Full-Year-2026-Increases-Quarterly-Dividend-7-5-to-0-86-Per-Share))
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth uses the disclosed FY2026 guidance midpoint, then gradually moderates growth over the out-years to reflect a mature clinical testing demand profile. ([s2.q4cdn.com](https://s2.q4cdn.com/390454341/files/doc_news/Quest-Diagnostics-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results--Provides-Guidance-for-Full-Year-2026-Increases-Quarter-35U43.pdf))

EBIT margin is modeled to recover modestly from the 2025 level (operating leverage and productivity), reaching ~14.5% by 2030 (target EBIT margin). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001022079/000102207926000015/dgx-20251231.htm))

Capex is kept near a normalized ~4.5% of sales range to support lab capacity/technology, while working-capital utilization (NWC as % of sales) is stabilized near historical levels excluding acquisition-driven noise. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001022079/000102207926000015/dgx-20251231.htm))

Tax shield includes estimated NOL carryforwards ($851M total across federal/state/foreign per disclosed balances), with NOL utilization percentage left as an explicit modeling assumption gap. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001022079/000102207926000015/dgx-20251231.htm))
key_risks: Regulatory, government investigation, and billing-compliance outcomes that could pressure volumes, pricing, and/or costs. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001022079/000102207926000015/dgx-20251231.htm))
Labor/supply cost inflation and productivity execution variability impacting operating margins. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001022079/000102207926000015/dgx-20251231.htm))
Working-capital volatility (receivables/payables timing) impacting near-term free cash flow conversion versus DCF assumptions.
